title: The selected-infinity E6 return and its fourteen fan values
old:

cap, fixed scalar, retained finite character and original selected
height, a full positive $\epsilon=w^{-1}$ loop has physical pair
$(-4,8)$ and class $27$ on the initial fan. Its complete fan image
consists of the fourteen odd residues modulo $28$.}

cap, fixed scalar, retained finite character and original selected
height, the actual normal and moving-cap comparison gives physical
pair $(-4,8)$ and class $27$ for the positive $\epsilon=w^{-1}$
loop on the initial fan. Its full native fan arrows transport those
integers and give precisely the fourteen odd residues modulo $28$.}

title: Every reduced and good cap at selected infinity
old:
\RungZero{The selected-infinity calculation extends to both complete
cap progressions: $M_6$ with translation by $-G$ and $m=3l+2$,
$l\geq0$, and $M_2$ with translation by $-3G$ and $m=3l$,
$l\geq1$. Both primitive norm signs, every retained finite character,
the entire annular reference and every selected lattice-basis fan
are included. Each initial physical pair is $(-4,8)$, and each full
fan image consists of the fourteen odd residues.}
new:
\RungZero{The proper relative cap products and their matched boundary
connections preserve the two integers $\int x^3$ and $\int p_1x$
separately for both complete progressions: $M_6$, translation by
$-G$, $m=3l+2$, $l\geq0$, and $M_2$, translation by $-3G$,
$m=3l$, $l\geq1$. They retain both primitive norm signs, every
admitted finite character, the full annular reference, each cap and
reference's common strict scalar range, and every selected basis
fan, carrying the initial pair $(-4,8)$ and the entire fourteen-odd-residue
fan image through the actual comparison maps.}

title: The selected-I3 source loop and all twenty-eight classes
old:
\RungZero{For the original E6 point line
$M_6=\mathcal O([6G]-[O])$, translation by $-G$, the quadratic
cap $(m,n)=(2,1)$ and its prescribed finite character and full
annular reference, the selected-I3 source loop has physical pair
$(47,-4)$ and class eight on the initial fan. Its complete
lattice-basis fan image is all of $\mathbb Z/28$. Every class has
an actual word of at most seven native flops from the initial fan.}
new:
\RungZero{For the original E6 point line
$M_6=\mathcal O([6G]-[O])$, translation by $-G$, the quadratic
cap $(m,n)=(2,1)$, its prescribed finite character and full annular
reference, the compact fixed-stratum and moving-cap comparison
fixes the selected-I3 source loop's physical pair $(47,-4)$ and
initial class eight. The actual native fan arrows transport those
integers, and the complete witness words of at most seven flops
from the initial fan realize all of $\mathbb Z/28$.}
operation: Add the exact geometric mechanism while retaining the stated choices and result; one or two sentences.

title: The complete $M_2$ order-three return
old:
\RungZero{For $M_2=\mathcal O([2G]-[O])$ and the three
chronological translations by $-G$, every good cap $m=3l$,
$l\geq1$, either primitive norm sign and each admitted finite
character have initial and vertical physical pair $(-3,-12)$.
For each chosen cap and its reference the scalar lies in their
common strict contraction range. Every selected basis fan has
the actual integer
\[
 A(P)=-\frac38(S-1)(S-3),\qquad
 S=x^2+xy+y^2,\quad (x,y)^t=P^{-1}e_2.
\]
Its exact image modulo 28 has sixteen elements.}
new:
\RungZero{For $M_2=\mathcal O([2G]-[O])$ and the three
chronological translations by $-G$, the full point-to-theta map
and compact-versus-reference cancellation give initial and vertical
physical pair $(-3,-12)$ for every good cap $m=3l$, $l\geq1$,
either primitive norm sign, each admitted finite character and full
annular reference, with the fixed scalar in the chosen cap and
reference's common strict contraction range. The actual directed
prism identities then give every selected basis fan the integer
\[
 A(P)=-\frac38(S-1)(S-3),\qquad
 S=x^2+xy+y^2,\quad (x,y)^t=P^{-1}e_2,
\]
whose exact image modulo $28$ has sixteen elements.}
